note: target = similarity to the lunar value, exp(-((earth - moon) / tolerance)^2), comparable across runs. TOTAL score (vs Moon) = weighted mean of target-scored criteria with weight > 0 only: c9_relief, c10_flat_base, c12_drivable, c13_roughness. rank_score (within run) is shown separately and never enters the total. Methods: c9_relief target (w 1), c10_flat_base target (w 1), c12_drivable target (w 1), c13_roughness target (w 1)

display.c16_day_night_swing: No Earth analog possible: near the lunar equator the surface reaches about 387-397 K at noon and cools to about 95 K just before sunrise, a day-night swing of roughly 290-300 K (LRO Diviner, Williams et al. 2017, Icarus, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2016.08.012). Earth's largest surface swings are far smaller. Shown for information, weight 0.
